findings.summary: FIXED in re-inspection: getExamAttemptById returns the full examSession (accessCode, whitelist of other user ids) to the examinee; same raw-include shape in start/create attempt responses. Pick fields by name or strip accessCode/whitelist for relation=examinee

FIXED in re-inspection: Answer key returned once status is COMPLETED regardless of showAnswersAfterSubmit=false (slider detail and get-by-id); gate on session.showAnswersAfterSubmit for relation=examinee

FIXED in re-inspection: Lockout is check-then-increment: N parallel guesses all read failures<5 before any INCR, so a burst exceeds the limit (only the gateway 5/min cap bounds it). Incr first atomically, compare, del on success

FIXED in re-inspection: invalidateWalletCaches after commit sits inside the try; a Redis error returns success:false for a committed balance change (caller may retry/double-apply). Same after-commit throw risk in webhook.service.ts:231,309. Make invalidation best-effort (catch+log)
FIXED in re-inspection: Access code from Math.random (not CSPRNG); use crypto.randomInt(100000,1000000); same in examsession service
Channel error listener logs warn only; a permanently failing consumer setup (authz_changed never delivered) has no health/readiness signal
Exact-email OR clause lets a TEACHER confirm whether an email is registered (no email returned); rate-limited 30/min; acceptable if intended for whitelist-by-email
